subject.title: LLM request failed: provider rejected request schema or tool payload — intermittent crash (Telegram + Anthropic)

question: Should direct Anthropic non-Fable models retain full signed-thinking replay, or should replay be limited to the active tool turn until upstream provider evidence confirms broader replay is valid?
rationale: The source path makes full replay plausible, but the issue has no provider error body and the related report has broader symptoms; the durable replay contract cannot be selected safely from this report alone.

options.title: Limit replay to the active tool turn
options.body: Adopt the narrower existing selection mechanism for direct non-Fable models and add a regression test for a tool-heavy follow-up request.

options.title: Retain full replay with contract proof
options.body: Keep current replay behavior only after upstream Anthropic documentation or a redacted successful trace proves full replay is required and accepted.

recommendation.title: Limit replay to the active tool turn
recommendation.body: Adopt the narrower existing selection mechanism for direct non-Fable models and add a regression test for a tool-heavy follow-up request.
